events.text: Five ideas, and they interlock: a pool of shared channels, a control channel coordinating it, talkgroups giving users a stable identity, grants moving each call to its channel — and FDMA or TDMA deciding how those channels share the spectrum.
Everything else in trunking — multisite networks, roaming, encryption, the protocol wars between P25, DMR, and TETRA — builds on these five.
When you're ready, those are waiting in the Field Guide.
Every segment's full write-up is linked below, with diagrams and sources.
If this helped, the whole Field Guide is free at gophertrunk dot org — and GopherTrunk itself, the open-source trunking scanner this course is built around, is on GitHub.
